references.label: Numbered targets
references.description: The standup targets marked 1 through 4 that complete their matching number in the pointer sequence.

references.label: Numbered rollovers
references.description: The rollovers marked 1 through 4 that complete their matching number in the pointer sequence.

references.label: Rotating pointer
references.description: The center indicator whose shown 50–500 value is scored by designated rollovers and kick-out holes.

references.label: Middle pointer-value lane
references.description: The central rollover that scores the value shown by the pointer.

references.label: Rail-feeding kick-out holes
references.description: The two holes that score the pointer value and send the ball down wire rails toward the flippers.

references.label: Roller Coaster wire rails
references.description: The guide rails carrying each kick-out return rapidly toward a flipper.
